name: fluxv4-warm-night
scene: It is deep night. A small cafe at closing time: a worn wooden counter come up to her waist, three warm pendant lamps hanging low over the counter, a rain-streaked window at the far edge of the room, glass jars, a small chalkboard menu with illegible marks, a folded cloth and two cooled cups slightly out of place. The room's own light owns her: the three pendant lamps are the only light on her, throwing deep amber pools down onto the counter and warm ochre light down her front, with warm bounce coming back up off the wood into her chin, throat and the underside of her ears. The rain-streaked window behind her is dark, cold and dim, and it stays thin at the edge of the frame. The whole palette is warm: amber, ochre, deep red-brown wood, cream fur warmed to honey where the lamplight lands, warm shadow.
pose: She stands upright behind the counter at her full height, spine straight, shoulders back, weight even on both feet, hips clear above the counter line. One forearm rests along the wood, the other hand wraps around a cream stoneware mug with the handle facing her and a thumb over the rim, that arm whole from shoulder to hand and the elbow in view. Her hair is loose and wispy: soft floofy layers with fine flyaway strands standing off her silhouette and catching the lamplight at their tips, matte and dry, fire red, a bright red-orange, deepest red at the roots. Ears relaxed and angled slightly forward, tips catching the amber light, head turned a little to her right, eyes looking down and away across the room at the work.
framing: Full-length distance shot: the camera is pulled back across the room, she stands upright at her full height and fills about two thirds of the frame height, with clear space above her ear tips and visible floor below both shoes, all inside the frame. Both ears and both feet are in the picture with margin to the top and bottom edges.
